premise: A management student who learned to code built himself a small team of AI agents that cannot act without his approval, then used that team to ship apps for other students.

chapters.title: I build with agents
chapters.lede: I am 23 and I study management at IIM Ranchi, in Ranchi. This page shows how a management student ended up running a team of AI agents.

chapters.title: Where I started
chapters.lede: I study management and learned to code alongside it. The path runs through a management degree at IIM Ranchi, a programming diploma at IIT Madras, and three internships.

chapters.title: Learning the models first
chapters.lede: Before I let any agent act, I wanted to know how models get things wrong. These projects and one research paper are where I learned that.

chapters.title: One assistant became {agents_word}
chapters.lede: Today the team is {agents_word} agents. Sends, deletes and public pushes wait for my approval.

chapters.title: What the agents actually do
chapters.lede: This is what happens between a voice note and a finished task. The risky steps stop and wait for me.

chapters.title: What the team shipped
chapters.lede: I used the agents to build tools for other students. Two of them are free to use today.

chapters.title: Going deeper
chapters.lede: The engineering detail lives in six case studies. Each one shows the architecture, and the code stays private.

chapters.title: What I believe and where I am going
chapters.lede: These are the rules I work by. If they fit what you need, email me.
